title: Among LAM customers who made transactions in the Czech Republic during 2012
question: Among LAM customers who made transactions in the Czech Republic during 2012, which customer had the lowest total consumption? Return their CustomerID and total consumption.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_001" AS CustomerID, SUM(T2."XCL_018") AS TotalConsumption
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T3 ON T2."XCL_015" = T3."XCL_004"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM'
  AND T2."XCL_011" >= '2012-01-01'
  AND T2."XCL_011" < '2013-01-01'
  AND T3."XCL_006" = 'CZE'
GROUP BY T1."XCL_001"
ORDER BY SUM(T2."XCL_018") ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT T1."XCL_001", SUM(T2."XCL_018") AS total_consumption
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS T2 ON T1."XCL_001" = T2."XCL_013"
INNER JOIN gasstations AS T3 ON T2."XCL_015" = T3."XCL_004"
WHERE T1."XCL_002" = 'LAM'
